title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 9: a day of fasting and confession, and the Levites' long prayer recalling God's faithfulness to Israel.

questions.text: On which day of the month did the children of Israel assemble with fasting and sackcloth?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:1 says they assembled on the twenty-fourth day of the month, with fasting, sackcloth and dirt on them.

questions.text: From whom did the offspring of Israel separate themselves?
questions.explanation: They separated themselves from all foreigners and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

questions.text: For how much of the day did they read in the book of the law?
questions.explanation: They read in the book of the law a fourth part of the day, and another fourth part they confessed and worshiped.

answers.text: A fourth part of the day
A third part of the day

questions.text: According to the prayer, where did God bring Abram out of?
questions.explanation: The prayer says God chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees and gave him the name Abraham.

questions.text: How does the prayer describe what happened to Israel's pursuers in the sea?
questions.explanation: God cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

answers.text: They were scattered like chaff by the wind
They were cast into the depths like a stone
They were turned back to Egypt
They were blinded by a cloud

questions.text: How did God lead Israel by night?
questions.explanation: God led them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light.

answers.text: With an angel carrying a torch
By the light of the moon

questions.text: What did God bring out of the rock for Israel?
questions.explanation: God gave them bread from the sky for their hunger and brought water out of the rock for their thirst.

questions.text: What did the people make for themselves, calling it the God who brought them out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: They made themselves a molded calf and said, "This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt."

questions.text: What does the prayer say about Israel's clothes during the forty years in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: God sustained them forty years in the wilderness; their clothes didn't grow old and their feet didn't swell.

answers.text: Their clothes were torn by thorns
They had to weave new clothes every year

questions.text: What do the people do at the end of the prayer?
questions.explanation: They make a sure covenant and write it, and their princes, Levites and priests seal it.

answers.text: They build a new altar of stone
They march out to war against their enemies
They make a sure covenant and write it
They decide to return to Babylon
